items.label: Soft & Comfortable Fabric
items.value: Made of 55% Nylon and 45% Spandex, this mesh bra features an ultra-soft, skin-friendly touch—lightweight, breathable, moisture-wicking, and stretchy for cloud-like all-day comfort, with the cups bouncing back perfectly after washing.

items.label: Elegant & Sexy
items.value: Featuring delicate wave edges, a hollow water drop design, crossover mesh, and a flattering V-neck, this full coverage bra enhances air circulation for added comfort while adding feminine charm and a trendy touch.

items: Custom Fit & Natural Shaping：Featuring W-shaped jelly and 3D molded cups，our jelly bra delivers a comfortable, personalized fit that hugs your curves，while the padded bra with semi-fixed pads adds extra coverage, enhances your natural shape, and keeps pads from shifting or bunching during wear.

items.label: Seamless & Wire-Free Comfort
items.value: Our wireless bras avoid pinching or digging, while the seamless bras ensure no visible lines under clothing—ideal as a tshirt bra for a smooth, polished look. Adjustable wide shoulder straps reduce shoulder pressure, and a free extension strap is included for a perfect fit. The U-shaped back smooths back fat for a sleek silhouette, with widened side wings slim side bulges, making it a great choice for plus size bras for women.

items.label: Versatile for All Occasions
items.value: A true multi-tasker for bras for women—suitable as a daily bra ,sport bra, sleep bra, workout bra, yoga bra. This comfortable bra meets all your dressing needs from morning to night.

items.label: Occasion Type
items.value: light sports bra, pullover bra, sleep bra, t-shirt bra, yoga bra
